value.title: 11/19 (Thu) Balance Adjustment Preview
value.content:
Hello, Heirs! This is Epic Seven.

We sincerely appreciate the interest and support of all of our Heirs who have continued their adventures with us in Epic Seven.


This is an advance notice regarding the 7 Heroes scheduled for regular balance adjustments following the update on 11/19.


1. Balance Adjustment Target


The following balance adjustments are scheduled to take place on November 19.


Hero

Grade

Name

5★ Moonlight

Death Dealer Ray

5★ Moonlight

Requiem Roana

5★ Moonlight

Eternal Wanderer Ludwig

5★ Moonlight

Hellion Lua

5★ Covenant

Summertime Iseria

5★ Covenant

Guard Captain Krau

4★ Covenant

Victorika


* The probability and number of turns are based on fully enhanced skills.

* Skill Cooldowns will not be changed unless stated.

* The values and skill descriptions mentioned in this preview may differ from the actual update.


1-1. Hero Balance Adjustments


1-1-1. Moonlight / 5★


Death Dealer Ray

Cloud of Death (Before)

Cloud of Death (After)

Releases a miasma of fatal poison, dispelling two buffs from all enemies and has a 100% chance to put them to sleep for 1 turn and inflict venom for 2 turns.

Releases a miasma of fatal poison, dispelling two buffs from all enemies and has a 100% chance to inflict two venom effects and sleep for 1 turn.

Cloud of Death (Awakened) (Before)

Cloud of Death (Awakened) (After)

Releases a miasma of fatal poison, dispelling two buffs from all enemies and a 100% chance to inflict sleep for 1 turn and venom for 2 turns. Grants an extra turn.

Releases a miasma of fatal poison, dispelling two buffs from all enemies, and has a 100% chance to inflict two venom effects and sleep for 1 turn. Grants an extra turn.

Constellation (Before)

Constellation (After)

Cancer

Scorpio


Death Dealer Ray is a Hero who subdues enemies with Venom and Sleep, but there were cases where enemy debuff-dispelling skills could remove Sleep somewhat easily. With this improvement, Cloud of Death will be changed to inflict two Venom effects and Sleep on all enemies for 1 turn, allowing him to maintain Sleep more reliably.

In addition, his Constellation will be changed from Cancer to Scorpio, allowing him to take turns more quickly and inflict debuffs on enemies.


Requiem Roana

Touch of Darkness (Before)

Touch of Darkness (After)

Attacks the enemy with magic, with a 75% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 1 turn.

Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack.

Attacks the enemy with magic, with a 75% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 1 turn.

Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and deals additional damage proportional to the caster's Attack.


Damage Dealt Decreased

Additional Damage Dealt Increased

Eternal Lament (Before)

Eternal Lament (After)

Attacks all enemies with a horde of illusions, dispelling one buff before increasing cooldowns by 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%.

Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, but penetrates the target's Defense by 50%.

Attacks all enemies with a horde of illusions, dispelling two buffs before increasing skill cooldowns by 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense.

Eternal Lament (Awakened) (Before)

Eternal Lament (Awakened) (After)

Attacks all enemies with a horde of illusions, dispelling one buff before increasing cooldowns by 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%.

Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, but penetrates the target's Defense.

Attacks all enemies with a horde of illusions, dispelling two buffs before increasing skill cooldowns by 1 turn and decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense.

When the target is a Hero, damage dealt increases proportional to the target's current Health.


With this improvement, Requiem Roana's ability to dispel buffs and deal damage will be strengthened.

First, Touch of Darkness will have its base damage and Soulburn damage decreased, while its additional damage proportional to Attack will be increased.

Eternal Lament will have the number of buffs it dispels increased from one to two. In addition, when awakened, an effect will be added that increases damage dealt proportional to the target Hero's current Health, allowing her to deal more powerful damage to enemy Heroes.


Eternal Wanderer Ludwig

Can You Handle This? (Before)

Can You Handle This? (After)

Attacks all enemies with the essence of magical engineering. When someone uses a Soulburn, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20% and penetration rate of this skill by 30%. Penetration rate increase effect can stack up to 2 times.

Attacks all enemies with the essence of magical engineering. When someone uses a Soulburn, increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20% and Defense penetration of this skill by 35%. Penetration increase effect can stack up to 2 times.


Eternal Wanderer Ludwig's Defense penetration will be strengthened, allowing him to deal more powerful damage to enemies with high Defense.

The penetration rate increase of Can You Handle This? will be increased from 30% to 35%, increasing its Defense penetration at two stacks from 60% to 70%.


Hellion Lua

Lua Squad (Before)

Lua Squad (After)

After being attacked by a Hero, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 10% and triggers a counterattack from all allies granted challenge.

After being attacked by a Hero, increases Combat Readiness of all allies by 15% and triggers a counterattack from all allies granted challenge.

Lua Squad (Skill Enhance) (Before)

Lua Squad (Skill Enhance) (After)

- +1% Combat Readiness

- +1% Combat Readiness

- +1% Combat Readiness

- +1% Combat Readiness

- +2% Combat Readiness

- +2% Combat Readiness

Lua's Challenge (Before)

Lua's Challenge (After)

Grants challenge to all allies, before increasing Defense of the caster for 2 turns.

Has a 100% chance to provoke all enemies for 1 turn.

Grants challenge to all allies, before granting increased Defense to the caster for 2 turns.

Has a 100% chance to inflict decreased Attack for 2 turns and provoke for 1 turn on all enemies.

Lua's Challenge (Awakened) (Before)

Lua's Challenge (Awakened) (After)

Grants challenge to all allies, before increasing Defense of the caster for 2 turns.

Decreases buff durations of all enemies by 1 turn and has a 100% chance to provoke for 1 turn.

Grants challenge to all allies, before granting increased Defense to the caster for 2 turns.

Decreases buff durations of all enemies by 1 turn and has a 100% chance to inflict decreased Attack for 2 turns and provoke for 1 turn.


Hellion Lua will be improved to withstand enemy attacks more reliably and trigger counterattacks from allies.

First, Lua's Challenge will be changed to inflict decreased Attack for 2 turns on all enemies in addition to Provoke, reducing the damage she receives from enemy attacks and improving her survivability.

In addition, Lua Squad will have the Combat Readiness increase granted to all allies after being attacked by a Hero increased from 10% to 15%, allowing allies to take turns more quickly.


1-1-2. Covenant / 5★


Summertime Iseria

Sword of Flowers! (Before)

Sword of Flowers! (After)

Attacks all enemies with swords of flowers, decreasing Attack for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the enemy.

Attacks all enemies with swords of flowers, inflicting decreased Attack and decreased Defense for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the target.

Sword of Flowers! (Awakened) (Before)

Sword of Flowers! (Awakened) (After)

Attacks all enemies with swords of flowers, decreasing Attack for 2 turns and increases Speed of the caster for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the enemy.

Attacks all enemies with swords of flowers, inflicting decreased Attack and decreased Defense for 2 turns, and granting increased Speed to the caster for 2 turns. At the end of the turn, detonates bombs inflicted on the target.


Summertime Iseria will be improved with the addition of Decrease Defense, allowing her to support allied attacks more effectively.

Sword of Flowers! will be changed to inflict decreased Defense on all enemies in addition to decreased Attack, allowing allies to deal more powerful damage to enemies.

 

Guard Captain Krau

Crimson Flame (Before)

Crimson Flame (After)

Attacks the enemy with a mystic blade and deals additional damage. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 20%. Damage dealt and additional damage increase proportional to the caster's Defense.

Attacks the enemy with a mystic blade and deals additional damage. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 25%. Damage dealt and additional damage increase proportional to the caster's Defense.


Additional Damage Dealt Increased

Scorching Flare (Before)

Scorching Flare (After)

After granting vigor to the caster for 3 turns, attacks all enemies by surrounding the area in flames, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health.

Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.

After granting vigor to the caster for 3 turns, attacks all enemies by surrounding the area in flames, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health.

Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.


Damage Dealt Increased

Soulburn Damage Dealt Increased

Scorching Flare (Awakened) (Before)

Scorching Flare (Awakened) (After)

After granting vigor to the caster for 3 turns, attacks all enemies by surrounding the area in flames, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%.

Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.

After granting vigor to the caster for 3 turns, attacks all enemies by surrounding the area in flames, and absorbs some of the damage dealt as Health. Increases Combat Readiness of the caster by 50%.

Cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow, and penetrates the target's Defense. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's Defense.


Damage Dealt Increased

Soulburn Damage Dealt Increased


Guard Captain Krau will be improved so that he can play a more active role in battle.

First, Crimson Flame will have its Combat Readiness increase raised from 20% to 25%, allowing him to take turns more quickly. Its additional damage will also be increased.

In addition, Scorching Flare will have its base damage and Soulburn damage increased, allowing him to deal more powerful damage to enemies.

 

1-1-3. Covenant / 4★


Victorika

Hilag's Pride (Before)

Hilag's Pride (After)

Attacks the enemy with a lance, with a 50% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns.

Attacks the enemy with a lance, with a 50% chance to inflict decreased Defense for 2 turns.


Damage Dealt Increased

Maelstrom Waltz (Before)

Maelstrom Waltz (After)

Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines.

Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines, and grants a barrier (proportional to Attack) to the caster for 2 turns.

Cooldown: 4 Turns

Cooldown: 3 Turns

Maelstrom Waltz (Awakened) (Before)

Maelstrom Waltz (Awakened) (After)

Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines, and grants counterattack to the caster for 3 turns.

Attacks all enemies by infiltrating deep into enemy lines, and grants a barrier (proportional to Attack) and counterattack to the caster for 2 turns.

Cooldown: 4 Turns

Cooldown: 3 Turns

Promised Glory (Before)

Promised Glory (After)

Attacks the enemy by rushing them down, and grants immunity to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.

Attacks the enemy by rushing them down, and grants immunity to all allies for 2 turns. Damage dealt increases proportional to the target's max Health.


Damage Dealt Increased


Victorika's offensive capabilities and survivability will both be strengthened.

First, Hilag's Pride will have its damage increased, strengthening her basic attack.

Maelstrom Waltz will have its cooldown reduced from 4 turns to 3 turns and will be changed to grant a barrier proportional to the caster's Attack for 2 turns, improving her survivability. However, with the reduced cooldown, the duration of the Counterattack granted when awakened will be adjusted from 3 turns to 2 turns.

Lastly, Promised Glory will have its damage increased proportional to the target's max Health, allowing her to deal more powerful damage to enemies with high Health.



That concludes the preview of the regular balance adjustments scheduled for November 19.


We closely monitor all feedback from our Heirs across various channels. We are grateful to be part of your Epic Seven journey. We will continue doing our best to improve our Heroes so that every character can find their place in your heart.



Thank you.
